name: ✈️ Zombie Air Force
desc:
Thank you for 1,000+ players!! "THANKYOU" or "SORRY" (without quotes) in shop for a free bonus! (new servers)

Words cannot express how much I appreciate everyone for playing. As a solo dev, I appreciate all the kind feedback and I will continue to update the game and make it the ultimate horde clearing co-op game! Please give suggestions, feedback, and ideas!

The zombie horde is coming. Get in the air!

✈️ Take the controls of your airforce!
🚀 Rain down rockets, chain gun fire and air strikes!
🛡️ Drop defenses to hold the line with your allies!
🧟 Blast through hordes of zombies and giant Behemoths!
💰 Earn credits and unlock over 180 upgrades!
🌍 Push the front line through every season. How far can YOUR squad make it?

Join the Group for +10% XP & Credits!
Invite friends for FREE XP & Credits buff!
Play on weekends for x2 buff!

⚠️ Alpha: expect bugs and tuning as we tweak progression. Join the community and provide feedback there.

llm.loop: fly jets/helicopters over a zombie horde -> rocket and gun them down, drop defenses with allies -> earn credits -> buy among 180 upgrades -> push the front line
llm.objectives: push the front line as far as the squad can
llm.instructions: pilot aircraft, fire rockets and chain guns, call air strikes, drop defenses
unique: horde defense from the air with mass zombie crowds
llm.thumbnails: fighter jet and attack helicopter over a bridge packed with zombies; $0 vs $1.5M upgrade
llm.complexity_notes: flight controls and crowd rendering of large hordes; many upgrades
